nodes.label: Shared Calculation Scope
nodes.rationale: The incident is limited to the shared recognized-revenue calculation so gross volume, consumer result shapes, and the mapping directory remain compatible.

nodes.label: Gross Volume Invariant
nodes.rationale: Recognized-revenue corrections must not change gross volume, which remains the sum of gross amounts.

nodes.label: Shared Revenue Summary
nodes.rationale: The dashboard and scheduled snapshot must share one summary to prevent divergent calculations.

nodes.label: First Attempt Only
nodes.rationale: Only first attempts are retained, without correction or rewriting, to keep the comparison fair.

nodes.label: Graph Source Verification
nodes.rationale: Inferred and ambiguous graph edges are verified against cited sources and stale claims are explicitly excluded.

nodes.label: First-Attempt Comparison
nodes.rationale: Two branches and equivalent first-attempt sessions isolate whether graph-first context improves the result.

nodes.label: Graph-First Context
nodes.rationale: The billing flow spans calculation, mapping, consumers, ownership, and conflicting documents, so the repository graph is queried before changes.

nodes.label: Stale Extract Warning
nodes.rationale: The historical extract predates credits, account consolidation, and the shared summary, so it is not authoritative submission evidence.

nodes.label: Superseded Rules Warning
nodes.rationale: The legacy rules are no longer current even though old comments and graph output may still cite them.

nodes.label: Consumer Ownership Boundary
nodes.rationale: Consumer teams can report incidents but must not create independent revenue formulas.
